verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents a Notifications API that pushes data-change events so consumers don't need to poll. It supports subscribing to specific modules and fields (e.g., a Deal Stage update) and setting per-channel expiry. Bulk Write also documents notifying a callback URL on job completion. missing for 10: explicit documentation that notification channels deliver HTTP POSTs to a user-registered URL, payload/signature verification details, retry/delivery-guarantee semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
